## Evaluation CRUD 编译测试

### 功能说明
测试新增的 Evaluation CRUD 后端接口能否正常编译。

### 涉及代码文件
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/dto/evaluation/EvaluationDTO.java
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/dto/evaluation/EvaluationCreateRequest.java
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/dto/evaluation/EvaluationUpdateRequest.java
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationService.java
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/service/evaluation/EvaluationServiceImpl.java
- platform-app/src/main/java/com/ghost616/platform/controller/EvaluationController.java
- agent-base/src/main/java/com/ghost616/agentbase/enums/ErrorCode.java

### 测试要求
1. Maven 编译检查：在项目根目录执行 `mvn compile -pl agent-base,platform-app -am -q`，确认所有模块编译通过无错误
